title.zh: 修正第655号法案中一处错误的法案，该法案题为《提供征收人头税额外方法的法案；废止现行法律中关于凡缴纳不动产税或工业税金额超过一比索者即无需缴纳人头税的规定；并免除某些小额不动产的土地税》
title.en: AN ACT TO CORRECT AN ERROR IN ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY-FIVE, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING ADDITIONAL METHODS OF ENFORCING THE PAYMENT OF THE CEDULA TAX; REPEALING THE PROVISIONS OF EXISTING LAW THAT NO PERSON SHALL BE REQUIRED TO PAY A CEDULA TAX WHO PAYS AS TAXES ON REAL ESTATE OR INDUSTRIAL TAXES AN AMOUNT IN EXCESS OF ONE PESO; AND EXEMPTING CERTAIN REAL ESTATE OF SMALL VALUE FROM LAND TAX.
title.orig: AN ACT TO CORRECT AN ERROR IN ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY-FIVE, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING ADDITIONAL METHODS OF ENFORCING THE PAYMENT OF THE CEDULA TAX; REPEALING THE PROVISIONS OF EXISTING LAW THAT NO PERSON SHALL BE REQUIRED TO PAY A CEDULA TAX WHO PAYS AS TAXES ON REAL ESTATE OR INDUSTRIAL TAXES AN AMOUNT IN EXCESS OF ONE PESO; AND EXEMPTING CERTAIN REAL ESTATE OF SMALL VALUE FROM LAND TAX.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa lỗi trong Đạo luật số 655 nhan đề 'Đạo luật quy định thêm các phương thức thực thi việc nộp thuế đầu người; bãi bỏ các quy định hiện hành rằng không ai phải nộp thuế đầu người nếu đã nộp thuế bất động sản hoặc thuế công nghiệp vượt quá một peso; và miễn trừ thuế đất đối với một số bất động sản có giá trị nhỏ'
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขข้อผิดพลาดในพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่655เรื่อง“พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดวิธีการเพิ่มเติมในการบังคับเก็บภาษีอากรหัว”เพิกถอนบทบัญญัติของกฎหมายที่มีอยู่ซึ่งระบุว่าไม่มีผู้ใดต้องชำระภาษีอากรหัวหากได้ชำระภาษีทรัพย์สินหรือภาษีอุตสาหกรรมเป็นจำนวนเกินหนึ่งเปโซและยกเว้นภาษีที่ดินสำหรับทรัพย์สินบางประเภทที่มีมูลค่าน้อย
title.id: Undang-Undang memperbaiki kesalahan dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 655 berjudul 'Undang-Undang Menetapkan Metode Tambahan untuk Menegakkan Pembayaran Pajak Kepala; Mencabut Ketentuan Undang-Undang yang Berlaku bahwa Tidak Ada Orang yang Wajib Membayar Pajak Kepala Jika Telah Membayar Pajak atas Harta Tak Bergerak atau Pajak Industri Melebihi Satu Peso; serta Membebaskan Pajak Tanah atas Harta Tak Bergerak Tertentu Bernilai Rendah'
title.ms: Akta membetulkan ralat dalam Akta Bilangan 655 bertajuk “Akta Menetapkan Kaedah Tambahan bagi Memaksakan Bayaran Cukai Kepala; Membatalkan Peruntukan Undang-undang Sedia Ada yang Menyatakan Bahawa Tiada Orang Diharuskan Membayar Cukai Kepala Jika Membayar Cukai Harta Tanah atau Cukai Perindustrian Sebanyak Lebih Daripada Satu Peso; dan Membebaskan Cukai Tanah bagi Harta Tanah Tertentu Bernilai Rendah”

Section two of paid Act Numbered Six hundred and fifty-five is hereby repealed, and there is
substituted in lieu thereof the following:
"Section 2. Paragraph (f) of section one of Act Numbered Three hundred and twenty, reading as follows: 'By
amending thirty-four of Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-three as follows:
"'Section 34. For the year nineteen hundred and two and succeeding years no person who shall pay to the
province and municipality together as taxes on real estate, or as an industrial tax, an amount in excess of one
peso, shall be required to pay the cedula tax. But every person so exempted from the cedula tax shall be
entitled to receive, and shall receive from the provincial treasurer, a cedula free of charge, to be used for the
same purpose of identification and to avoid disqualification, to testify, to execute an instrument, to vote, or to
hold office. Cedulas so issued shall be in the same form as those issued in return for the payment of one
peso, and there shall be printed across their face the words "Issued Free" '-"is hereby repealed and stricken
from said Act Numbered Three hundred and twenty, and hereafter any person paying taxes on real estate or
industrial taxes in an amount in excess of one peso, shall not thereby be exempted from the payment of the

All laws or parts of laws, including section thirty-four of the Provincial Government Act as set out
in section two of Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-three, inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are
hereby repealed.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 8, 1903.
